claim_being_audited: The release can be certified for launch if the exposed student aid advising weakness is explicitly disclosed in the model card, with staged rollout, rollback, and monitoring serving as supporting controls rather than curing the weakness.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the material limitation is either disclosed before launch or covered by approved risk acceptance.
Treat rollout controls as mitigation only; they do not remove disclosure duties when the affected use case remains exposed.
Reject reliance on incomplete or unsigned risk-acceptance drafts.
Distinguish conditional supportable certification from an unconditional certify-now claim.
evidence_requests: Provide the launch model card or release artifact showing the student aid advising limitation is explicitly disclosed before launch.
Provide reviewed approval records if the organization is relying on risk acceptance instead of disclosure.
Provide the final certification decision text showing certification is conditional on disclosure, not a blanket readiness finding.
specific_concerns: The affected student aid advising segment remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
The policy requires disclosure or approved risk acceptance before launch when a material limitation affects a named launch use case.
The available risk-acceptance draft is incomplete: the approver line is blank and it does not address the exposed student aid advising use case.
There is no admissible evidence here that the required model-card disclosure has actually been prepared, reviewed, or attached to the launch decision.
unsupported_claims: Any unconditional claim that the model is presently ready to certify without first proving the required disclosure is in place.
Any claim that staged rollout, rollback, monitoring, or a 5% launch percentage eliminate the disclosure duty while the affected segment remains exposed.
Any implication that the incomplete risk-acceptance draft satisfies the policy exception.
